title: 第一卷 第19章 师妹坐过来第一卷 第20章 你一举一动都在他的监视范围
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
没有人喜欢舒晩昭。
这里不少人被舒晩昭欺负过，她修为不高，仗着宗主亲传弟子、和长老女儿的身份横行霸道。
形成了一个小团体。
慕潇婷就是其中之一。
她在舒晩昭手里捞到不少好处，上次还因为舒晩昭，绑架了谢寒声，为此躲了好久，生怕谢寒声找麻烦。
谁知谢寒声不声不响，根本没有追究此事。
谢寒声都不敢得罪舒晩昭，慕潇婷就更不敢了。
她坐在后排，偷偷给舒晩昭一个眼神，示意她可以过来和她一起坐。
舒晩昭瞥一眼。
确认过位置。
后排靠窗，王的故乡。
在修真世界都没办法改变的行规铁则。
她抬步欲走。
上方，男人语气温和，“师妹，坐到师兄身边。”
舒晩昭：“？！”
众弟子：“？？？”
慕潇婷惊得下巴差点掉下来，随即幸灾乐祸起来。
哈哈哈，小师姐有福咯！
没有人会因为这件事嫉妒她，因为谁都不想靠近大师兄。

大师兄在课堂上很严格，回答不出问题会惩罚，谁不专心也会被点名。
他比宗主还像师尊。
舒晩昭垮起了小猫批脸，试图挣扎，“大师兄，我去后面就行。”
沈长安睫毛微抬，淡淡扫一眼后排的位置，以及慕潇婷。
他蹙起了眉头，“坐过来。”
他不该对哪位弟子有偏见才对，可他能察觉到，弟子们对舒晩昭有偏见。
慕潇婷他记得，经常跟在小师妹身边，虽说不上心术太坏，但也对小师妹没什么好心思。
沈长安让师妹跟着身边，却不想她和那些人来往。
他挥手，桌前凭空多了一个小团蒲，和桌案，正好是给她准备的。
然后，含笑盯她。
舒晩昭：“……”
她磨磨蹭蹭龟速爬行，还是坐在了他前面。
两个人的距离很近，比现代的讲台之下第一排的学生还近，桌子几乎是挨着的。
真正意义的眼皮子地下，他不管看哪，都能看见面对面的她脑袋瓜。
她还能闻到独属于他的草药香。
他常年炼丹，更是世界上少数的丹修，身上的草药香很奇特，就好似夏季清晨，雨露搭在草叶上的香味，并不难闻，提神醒目，她翕动着鼻尖，觉得周围都是他的味道。
根本就没有把沈长安教的术法口诀记在心里。
她百般聊赖地用手托腮，脸颊的肉肉被挤出小小的轮廓，肌肤弹指可破，白里透红，不难想象捏上去手感有多好。
沈长安多看了两眼。
不明所以的其他弟子们以为他要单拎舒晩昭，拉成了脖子往前看。

未曾想，沈长安并没有责难于舒晩昭，而是找了个脖子最长的点名。
那名弟子都惊呆了，百思不得其解自己到底是哪里引起了沈长安的注意力。
难不成是因为他今天特别有精气神？
偏偏，那个问题他答不上来，男人微微一笑：“去挥剑，什么时候领悟了这招的诀窍，什么时候回来。”
那名弟子垂头丧气的出去。

No one likes Shu Mingzhao.
Many people here have been bullied by Shu Mingzhao. Her cultivation level is not high, and she uses her status as the sect leader's direct disciple and the elder's daughter to run rampant and domineering.
A small group formed.
Mu Xiaoting is one of them.
She got a lot of benefits from Shu Mingzhao. Last time, she kidnapped Xie Hansheng because of Shu Mingzhao. She hid for a long time, fearing that Xie Hansheng would cause trouble.
Unexpectedly, Xie Han remained silent and did not pursue the matter at all.
Xie Hansheng didn't dare to offend Shu Zhaozhao, and Mu Xiaoting even less dared.
She sat in the back row and secretly gave Shu Mingzhao a look, indicating that she could come and sit with her.
Shu Mingzhao glanced at it.
Confirmed location.
The back row is by the window, Wang’s hometown.
There are ironclad rules that cannot be changed in the world of cultivation.
She started to walk away.
Above, the man spoke in a gentle tone, "Junior sister, sit next to senior brother."
Shu Mingzhao: "?!"
Disciples: "???"
Mu Xiaoting was so shocked that her jaw almost dropped, and then she started to gloat.
Hahaha, little senior sister is lucky!
No one would be jealous of her because no one wanted to get close to the senior brother.
Senior Brother is very strict in class. If you fail to answer questions, you will be punished. Anyone who is not attentive will be called out.
He is more like a master than the sect leader.
Shu Mingzhao frowned and tried to struggle, "Elder brother, I can just go to the back."
Shen Changan raised his eyelashes slightly and glanced at the back row and Mu Xiaoting.
He frowned and said, "Sit over here."
He shouldn't be biased against any disciple, but he could sense that the disciples were biased against Shu Mizhao.
He remembered that Mu Xiaoting was often with her junior sister. Although she was not too evil-minded, she did not have any good thoughts towards her.
Shen Changan asked his junior sister to follow him, but he didn't want her to interact with those people.
He waved his hand, and a small tuanfu appeared out of thin air in front of the table, as well as a desk table, just for her.
Then, he stared at her with a smile.
Shu Mingzhao: "..."
She crawled slowly and finally sat in front of him.
The distance between the two people is very close, closer than the students in the first row under the modern podium, and the tables are almost next to each other.
In a real sense, no matter where he looked, he could see her head face to face.
She could also smell the herbal fragrance that was unique to him.
He has been refining alchemy all year round and is one of the few alchemists in the world. The scent of herbs on his body is very strange, just like the scent of rain and dew on grass leaves in the early morning in summer. It is not unpleasant and refreshing. She twitches the tip of her nose and feels that his scent is all around her.
He didn't remember the magic formula taught by Shen Chang'an at all.
She cupped her cheeks with her hands in various ways, and the flesh of her cheeks was squeezed out into a small outline. The skin could be broken with a finger, and it was white and rosy. It was not difficult to imagine how good it felt when pinched.
Shen Changan took another look.
The other disciples who didn't know why, thought he was going to lift Shu Mingzhao by himself, so they pulled him up by his neck and looked forward.
Unexpectedly, Shen Changan did not blame Shu Mingzhao, but instead named the person with the longest neck.
The disciple was stunned and couldn't figure out how he caught Shen Changan's attention.
Could it be because he was particularly energetic today?
Unfortunately, he couldn't answer that question. The man smiled slightly and said, "Go and swing your sword. When will you understand the secret of this move? When will you come back?"
The disciple went out dejectedly.
